ConnectionStrings.//: SQLite for local development. For production use a Postgres string containing 'Host=' and the provider switches automatically.

Shopify.//ApiKey: Partner dashboard -> Client ID. Safe to commit; it is public.
Shopify.//ApiSecret: Partner dashboard -> Client secret. NEVER commit. Use 'dotnet user-secrets set Shopify:ApiSecret <value>' locally, or an environment variable in production.
Shopify.//AppUrl: Public HTTPS base URL of this app. Must match the App URL in the Partner dashboard exactly.
Shopify.//Scopes: Keep minimal. Every extra scope is another permission a merchant can decline and another question at App Review.
Shopify.//ApiVersion: Pinned deliberately. Shopify supports each version for a year; bump this on purpose, not by accident.

Billing.//UseTestCharges: true means the merchant sees a real approval screen but is never billed. Development stores can ONLY accept test charges. Set false for production.

ScanSchedule.//Enabled: Turn off in development so a local run does not start making requests to real storefronts.
ScanSchedule.//Cron: UTC. Weekly by default: storefront markup rarely changes daily, and each run costs real requests against merchants' shops.
ScanSchedule.//WorkerCount: One is right until a weekly pass no longer finishes comfortably.

DataProtection.//KeyRingPath: Where the keys that encrypt stored access tokens live. Must persist across restarts and be shared by every replica, or stored tokens become unreadable and every merchant must reinstall.
